title: Many people want salvation.
paragraphs:
Jesus never hid the cost of discipleship.
He spoke it plainly:
“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.” — Luke 9:23
Following Jesus means laying down pride, comfort, control, reputation, and sometimes even relationships.

Salvation is the gift of grace.
But discipleship is the path of surrender.

The world says: protect yourself.
Jesus says: deny yourself.

The world says: follow your heart.
Jesus says: follow Me.

The cross was never meant to be comfortable.
It was meant to change everything.
The question isn't whether Jesus is worth following.
Are we willing to carry the cross?
